# mehrasaur Voxel Buildings

One model from mehrasaur's Voxel Buildings pack, released under CC0 1.0
(public domain dedication) on OpenGameArt; no attribution required.
Licence checked on the page 2026-11-14. The user supplied the pack's zip;
`10.vox` here is byte-identical to `dist/vox/10.vox` in it.

| File | Source | sha256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `10.vox` (40 x 40 x 126) | https://opengameart.org/content/voxel-buildings (`Voxel Buildings.zip`, `dist/vox/10.vox`) | `3ba9b19b8b3857c5c6492442f863b3da1698bc72acec5517a455051321e8b5fa` |

A small shop with a blue awning and two potted bushes, on a green ground
plate (z 0 and 1). The game's station building
(`assets/generated/station-house.vox`, made by `tools/genassets.ts` with
`stationHouse` in `src/assets/station.ts`) leaves the plate out, crops to
the building, turns it 180 degrees so the front faces +y and scales it
2x.
